subject.title: [Bug] Agent context window fragmentation during concurrent subagent tool calls

question: Should a parent waiting on several subagents receive the final combined handoff in stable spawn order, or is completion order an intentional part of the push-based contract?
rationale: Current docs and v2026.7.1 define push delivery plus final aggregation but do not specify aggregate ordering, and the issue supplies no concrete misassociation failure that resolves the product tradeoff automatically.

options.title: Require a concrete repro first
options.body: Keep the current contract until a latency-controlled transcript demonstrates an unusable or misassociated combined handoff, then fix only the proven aggregation boundary.

options.title: Guarantee spawn order
options.body: Define final waiting-parent aggregates to sort children by stable registry spawn sequence while leaving ordinary push completions unchanged.

options.title: Keep completion order
options.body: Document completion order as intentional and rely on stable child/run identity plus taskName metadata for requester synthesis.

recommendation.title: Require a concrete repro first
recommendation.body: Keep the current contract until a latency-controlled transcript demonstrates an unusable or misassociated combined handoff, then fix only the proven aggregation boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged multi-child wake and aggregation work is the closest current-main implementation history for this contract.
